scheme_name: Assistance For Delivery / Miscarriage Of Pregnancy / Termination Of Pregnancy To Female Differently Abled Person
other_conditions: Applicant must hold the identity card issued by the welfare board for the differently abled.
Eligibility category noted in source: Differently Abled
benefits_summary: Provides a total of ₹6,000 (₹1,000 per month) for delivery and ₹3,000 for miscarriage/termination of pregnancy to a female differently abled person.
documents_required: Identity card issued by the welfare board for the differently abled
